name: llvm
description: Collection of modular and reusable compiler and toolchain technologies, including the LLVM core libraries and Clang, required by Mesa for the llvmpipe, r300, r600, and radeonsi Gallium drivers.
build: cd llvm-project/llvm/build && CC=gcc CXX=g++ cmake -G Ninja -S .. -B . -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$PREFIX" -D CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RPATH=ON -D LLVM_ENABLE_FFI=ON -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D LLVM_BUILD_LLVM_DYLIB=ON -D LLVM_LINK_LLVM_DYLIB=ON -D LLVM_ENABLE_RTTI=ON -D LLVM_ENABLE_PROJECTS=clang -D LLVM_TARGETS_TO_BUILD="host;AMDGPU" -D LLVM_BINUTILS_INCDIR="$PREFIX/include" -D LLVM_INCLUDE_BENCHMARKS=OFF -D CLANG_DEFAULT_PIE_ON_LINUX=ON -D CLANG_CONFIG_FILE_SYSTEM_DIR=/etc/clang -D LLVM_TOOL_GOLD_BUILD=OFF -W no-dev
